title: NVIDIA Acquires Sutskever: Invests in SSI Lab, Adding a Major Piece to Its Computing Power Portfolio
excerpt: According to the Wall Street Journal, NVIDIA has officially invested in Safe Superintelligence (SSI), a highly confidential AI laboratory founded by Ilya Sutske
content_html:
According to the Wall Street Journal, NVIDIA has officially invested in Safe Superintelligence (SSI), a highly confidential AI laboratory founded by Ilya Sutskever, co-founder of OpenAI and former chief scientist. The investment is described as "substantial," but the specific financial terms were not disclosed.

The core of this deal is computing power. According to the agreement, SSI will be allowed to use a large amount of NVIDIA's flagship GPU hardware, which would increase its computing power by "an order of magnitude"—previously, the company mainly relied on Google-made TPU chips. NVIDIA decided to invest after getting a glimpse of SSI's research progress, showing its recognition of Sutskever's technical approach.

A Secret Giant Comes to Light: Valuation of 30 Billion Dollars

SSI was founded by Sutskever in 2024. The company's positioning is extremely clear—to achieve "safe superintelligence" in one step, that is, an AI capable of performing any task humans can do without threatening humanity.

With Sutskever's strong reputation in academia, SSI quickly attracted about $2 billion in funding from top venture capital firms such as a16z and Sequoia Capital. Its valuation reached approximately $30 billion (about 203.3 billion yuan) last year, while its research details remain highly confidential to this day.

This is not the first time NVIDIA has bet on key personnel who left OpenAI. In March this year, NVIDIA had already reached a similar investment agreement with Thinking Machines Lab, founded by former OpenAI Chief Technology Officer Miriam Prabhu, whose first AI model released this month was trained using NVIDIA hardware.

From Prabhu to Sutskever, NVIDIA is systematically binding the top research forces in the AI field, building a deeply integrated computing power ecosystem on top of GPU sales—those who can train the next generation of models must enter NVIDIA's orbit.

content_html_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，NVIDIA 正式投资了由 OpenAI 联合创始人、前首席科学家 Ilya Sutskever 创立的高度机密的 AI 实验室 Safe Superintelligence（SSI）。 该投资被描述为“实质性”，但具体财务条款并未披露。

这笔交易的核心是算力。 根据协议，SSI将被允许大量使用NVIDIA的旗舰GPU硬件，这将使其计算能力提高“一个数量级”——此前，该公司主要依赖谷歌制造的TPU芯片。 NVIDIA在看到SSI的研究进展后决定投资，表明了其对Sutskever技术方法的认可。

秘密巨头曝光：估值300亿美元

SSI 由 Sutskever 于 2024 年创立。 该公司的定位极其明确——一步实现“安全超级智能”，即一种能够执行人类能完成的任何任务而不威胁人类的人工智能。

凭借 Sutskever 在学术界的良好声誉，SSI 很快吸引了 a16z 和红杉资本等顶级风险投资公司约 20 亿美元的资金。 去年其估值达到约300亿美元（约合2033亿元人民币），而其研究细节至今仍处于高度机密状态。

这并不是 NVIDIA 第一次押注于离开 OpenAI 的关键人员。 今年 3 月，NVIDIA 已经与 OpenAI 前首席技术官 Miriam Prabhu 创立的 Thinking Machines Lab 达成了类似的投资协议，该实验室本月发布的首个 AI 模型就是使用 NVIDIA 硬件进行训练的。

从Prabhu到Sutskever，NVIDIA正在系统性地捆绑AI领域的顶尖研究力量，在GPU销售之上构建深度融合的算力生态系统——谁能训练下一代模型，谁就必须进入NVIDIA的轨道。
